normativePrecedence: Where this JSON and the Spec prose disagree on an outcome-affecting requirement, the disagreement is a protocol defect that blocks timed runs until a dated amendment resolves it; neither artifact is silently authoritative over the other.

baselineCutoff.rule: All metric-affecting work after this commit is treatment work; executions use fresh external checkouts and preserve versioned two-arm rerun evidence.

claimScope.customer: one noninteractive coding agent acting for a solo developer or small product team
claimScope.application: owner-private AI chat with streamed durable assistant progress

fixture.generatedPatternsArm: snapback-only-authoring-constraint; the Convex arm implements the same behavioral facts idiomatically

sampling.outlierPolicy: retain every valid sample; invalidate only a documented instrument failure with a named documenter and retained rationale

statisticsImplementation.rule: The exact estimator, bootstrap target, resample count, seed, and invalid-sample replacement rule must be pinned by content digest in a dated amendment before the first timed sample.

assistancePolicy.rule: One identical agent model/tool configuration serves both arms; only the pinned per-arm documentation corpus may differ, and both must be pinned in a dated amendment before the first timed sample — never left to the runner. The asymmetry is material: the comparator is abundantly represented in model training data while the Snapback arm depends on its shipped guide.

runCapsule.rule: A content-addressed run capsule — neutral fixture prompt bytes, each arm's starting scaffold tree digest, harness and analysis implementation digests, machine image, hardware/network policy, exact package integrities, provider/region/plan, and credential preconditions — must be pinned in a dated amendment before the first timed sample.

metricDefinitions.rule: An event schema pinning timer start/stop events for first-local-live-row and hosted-live-URL, the top-level-command and wrapper policy, token and tool-call accounting classes, per-metric aggregation across the seven samples for command/token/tool-call/failure/retry/skip margins, and an expected-refusal taxonomy distinguishing required negative witnesses from actual failures must be pinned in a dated amendment before the first timed sample.

convexLocalLegTopology.rule: Whether the comparator local leg is the isolated cloud development deployment, account-free local Convex (beta), or both with a preregistered sensitivity arm must be decided in a dated amendment before the first timed sample; the topologies are materially different workflows with different latency profiles.

applicationAuthSetup.rule: Each arm's identity provider, two-principal account fixture, credential provisioning, and timed-versus-excluded setup boundary must be pinned in a dated amendment before the first timed sample; server-derived identity and cross-user refusal are required product facts in both arms.

frontendHostingBoundary.rule: hosted-live-URL means the public origin serving the actual React application. The comparator deploy command pushes backend functions; each arm's frontend host, credentials, and timed/excluded provisioning boundary must be pinned in a dated amendment before timed hosted samples.

nonInferiority.decisionStatistic: point-estimate-median; p95 and bootstrap-95ci are informational and cannot rescue or overturn a margin

scoringAnchors.rule: Per-dimension, per-arm 0/1/2 anchors — including what counts as direct reproducible evidence for comparator dashboard/CLI artifacts — must be preregistered in a dated amendment before the first timed sample and before any arm's evidence is revealed to the anchor author; managed-provider evidence may not be scored down merely for differing from Snapback's receipt vocabulary.
scoringAnchors.scorer: A model family that did not author either arm scores the rubric with a retained dimension-level transcript before adjudication; the adjudicator resolves disputes under the dispute rule rather than scoring first.

outcomes.continue: All checkpoint gates and margins pass with Snapback evidence confidence 16/16 and no required skip.
outcomes.stop: Any security/correctness, late-effect, target-confusion, secret-exposure, destructive-cleanup, or false-claim defect.
outcomes.reprioritize: Correctness passes but a margin fails, one gap dominates, or the proposed hosted adapter cannot implement the profile honestly.

preRunDisposition: A required pre-run skip with no Stop-class defect yields a readiness disposition of reprioritize; it is not a first-hour, completeness, or confidence outcome, and no timed comparison result exists until both arms complete timed samples under this protocol.

comparatorInventory.capability: per-agent isolated deployment and scoped token
online resumable migration with dry run

adjudication.disputeRule: A disputed interpretation requires a dated LLP 0063/0075 amendment before rerun.
